name: AI Application software (quality growth at a reset multiple)
thesis: A basket of durable application-software franchises with high retention and strong free-cash conversion, bought after a broad de-rating driven by the fear that AI agents will deflate per-seat demand. Bentley (infrastructure engineering) is the value leg: ~11% revenue growth, ~35% FCF margin and ~99% account retention, trading near its 52-week low at roughly 20x free cash flow after a ~45% fall from the high. ServiceNow and SAP are quality-growth legs held on the same secular durability case rather than on a trough multiple, since both have already re-rated well off their lows. The bet resolves as recurring-revenue and net-retention data show whether AI expands or erodes the seat base; the sleeve is fair-priced, not a screaming dislocation, and only Bentley currently sits at the discounted valuation the headline metrics describe.
